naive_analytical_prediction.note: v3 trajectories (DMAC-TRZ-X compound) confirmed naive LLM uses simplified Strickler-Berg form k_F ≈ 0.667·f·ν̃². Applied to anthracene inputs (E=3.43 eV → ν̃=27,664 cm⁻¹, f=0.10): 0.667 × (27664)² × 0.10 = 5.105e7 s⁻¹. This is what naive WOULD report; relay rate limit prevented a fresh live trial.

reproducibility_evidence_from_v3.note: Two independent naive runs give DIFFERENT τ_r — LLM is stochastic. ChemMaster's formula MCP path is deterministic Python → bit-identical every run.
